label: Homicide rate
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = WHO Mortality Database cause-of-death registrations as submitted by member states (civil registration, ICD-coded, Assault = X85-Y09 and predecessors), redistributed by the OECD Causes of Mortality dataflow over SDMX, 49 countries, 1960-2024, sex-split as published; witness tier = UNODC intentional-homicide compilation via OWID (criminal-justice and vital-registration sources with imputation, near-global, 1990-2023). Authenticity first per ADR-0008: the two tiers count differently and are displayed beside each other, never blended.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): OECD DF_COM = OECD Terms and Conditions, attribution required (content: WHO Mortality Database); OWID witness = CC-BY-4.0.

label: Infant mortality
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = official as-reported series: the hand-curated USSR official series (one citation per point, curation gate ADR-0007) and UN DYB Table 15 rates across 12 editions, 2007-2024 (published only for UN completeness codes C or "|"); witness tier = UN IGME harmonized estimates via OWID for cross-country comparability. Authenticity first per ADR-0008: the two tiers are displayed beside each other, never blended.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): curated points = facts with citation, small extracts, clearly attributed (catalog/curated/README.md); UN DYB = UN data reuse policy (attribution required, no endorsement implied); OWID witness = CC-BY-4.0.

label: Life expectancy at birth
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = UN DYB Table 4, national official statistics as reported, 12 editions, 2007-2024, sex-split (Male/Female) as printed by the collector; witness tier = OWID "life expectancy" (UN WPP estimates and historical reconstructions — Riley, HMD — both sexes), near-global, longer span (to 1875 for some entities). Authenticity first per ADR-0008: displayed beside each other, never blended.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): UN DYB = UN data reuse policy (attribution required, no endorsement implied); OWID witness = CC-BY-4.0.
